extractIntro: Many videos already have subtitles added by the uploader. VidGrab fetches them for you. No speech recognition is needed, so it's fast and doesn't use your transcription quota.
noSubsHint: No "Subtitles" tab on your video? Switch to the "AI transcription" tab to create subtitles from speech.
home: Go to the home page to paste a video link
title: Subtitles and Transcription
subtitle: Get existing subtitles, create subtitles from speech, or translate them into another language.
_note: wording: BA review — English drafted with AI
step1: Paste the video link into the download box on the home page and click to get the video info.
step2: On the result card, open the "Subtitles" tab (it only shows when the video has subtitles).
step3: Choose a language and format (SRT/VTT), then click "Download subtitles".
